records.words: I remember feeding Zehra and waiting too long. This time I want to actually answer someone when I visit.
The map fits, but the news disappears behind the call area. I know the first move, so I am calling them.
Zehra again. I remember that her own barley mattered. I am going there before I send anything.

I came back wanting a spoken answer. I called, found Zehra, and started walking. Twenty seconds later it still says twenty game minutes until arrival. I remember this waiting. The clock says replies slow it down; I am going back to the notebook to see if that helps. This note is late.
There it is. I came to listen is a real answer to being at her door. I want to hear what she does with it.
My sentence is confirmed, but I have not heard an answer. Maybe she needs the visit to continue. I do not want to buy a response with grain yet.
Yusuf says Come in. I cannot tell whether that answers my listening sentence or just means the visit has started. I will look at the house again.

I want to leave. I got to say I came to listen, but now I am watching Come in and a disabled sentence. I do not feel a conversation developing, and I do not want another round of grain and waiting tonight.
The chance to speak briefly lifted me, but I am leaving with the same waiting feeling. I am not curious enough to start another visit.

I am stopping here. Saying I came to listen felt better than arriving with only grain or pressure, but I did not find enough conversation to stay. I would not return voluntarily to this session or another evening as it stands. I would not leave it running. I selected the stopping topic locally; it filled the note itself. I typed nothing and did not submit.
